policy: Stations listed here are not probed by find_epg_urls.py. Their epg_sources.json entries are locked. Re-open one only when a new source (API, feed, accessible HTML) appears.

9.name: Radio QK
9.reason: No crawlable weekly grid on the homepage; the schedule is only announced on air or by email.
9.next: Ask radioqk@radioqk.org for the parrilla, then add it as a JSON source.

10.name: Radio Pica
